skill.name: inbox-placement-monitor
skill.description: Use when you need to review post-send inbox placement from seed-list results, Gmail Postmaster Tools, Microsoft SNDS, and ESP exports. It reports provider-level inbox, spam, and promotions placement, sender reputation trends, send-over-send regressions, and a SEND-S placement snapshot. It does not run SPF, DKIM, or DMARC pre-flight checks or compute the full EQS audit.
skill.summary: Monitor post-send inbox placement and sender reputation trends by provider.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: No prompt injection, malicious data exfiltration, arbitrary path traversal, or hidden reconnaissance intent was found in the reviewed files. Most static alerts are Markdown links or inline-code false positives; one documented Resend seed-send command is a real medium-risk external command because it can send live email with --live.

remediation.issue: Live seed-send command can trigger external email sending.
remediation.suggestion: Keep dry-run as the default and require explicit user confirmation before adding --live or sending through Resend.

content.user_title: Monitor Inbox Placement After Every Send
content.value_statement: Email teams need to know where messages actually land after a campaign. This skill turns seed-list, Postmaster, SNDS, and ESP exports into provider-level placement trends and clear follow-up actions.
actual_capabilities: Reads seed-list placement results by mailbox provider.
Compares inbox, spam, and promotions placement against thresholds.
Summarizes Gmail Postmaster and Microsoft SNDS reputation trends.
Computes send-over-send placement deltas when a baseline exists.
Produces a SEND-S placement snapshot for later audit handoff.
Marks missing provider data as NEEDS_INPUT instead of assuming success.
limitations: Requires user-provided exports or pasted telemetry.
Does not run SPF, DKIM, or DMARC pre-send checks.
Does not compute the full EQS score or enforce vetoes.
Seed-send automation only applies when Resend is the selected ESP.

use_cases.title: Diagnose a Placement Drop
use_cases.description: Compare current seed-list results with the prior send and name each mailbox provider regression.

use_cases.title: Track Sender Reputation
use_cases.description: Turn Gmail Postmaster and Microsoft SNDS exports into a clear reputation trend after each campaign.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Audit Snapshot
use_cases.description: Create a SEND-S placement summary that an email quality auditor can use for a later go or no-go review.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Placement Read
prompt_templates.prompt: Track inbox placement for this sending domain after my last campaign. I have seed-list results by provider and ESP deliverability metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Provider Regression Check
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare one send against a prior baseline.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare this seed-list test against my prior baseline. Show which providers moved to spam or promotions and by how many percentage points.

prompt_templates.title: Reputation Trend Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Combine placement data with reputation exports.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Gmail Postmaster and Microsoft SNDS exports with this seed-list result. Identify reputation downgrades, complaint spikes, and trap-hit risks.

prompt_templates.title: SEND-S Handoff Snapshot
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced handoff to a quality audit.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a SEND-S placement snapshot for this promotional send. Label every metric, call out missing providers, and recommend the next skill.

output_examples.input: Seed-list results show Gmail inbox 82%, Outlook junk 18%, Yahoo inbox 95%, and Apple missing.
output: Gmail is below the inbox target and needs review.
Outlook shows a junk-folder regression that should be investigated.
Yahoo is holding versus the threshold.
Apple is NEEDS_INPUT because no seed result was supplied.

output_examples.input: Postmaster export shows domain reputation changed from High to Medium and spam rate rose from 0.08% to 0.14%.
output: The spam-rate increase crosses the 0.1% red line used by the SEND-S placement read.
Route the issue to deliverability QA if authentication or setup changed.

output_examples.input: No prior send baseline is available for a new retention program.
output: No regression delta can be calculated yet.
Record this run as the baseline for the next placement review.
Continue only after missing provider data is supplied.

best_practices: Provide seed-list results for Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, and Apple when possible.
Include prior send baselines so placement changes can be measured.
Label each metric source as measured, user-provided, or estimated.
anti_patterns: Do not treat missing provider data as a pass.
Do not use this skill for SPF, DKIM, or DMARC setup checks.
Do not compute the full EQS score inside this placement review.

faq.question: What data does this skill need?
faq.answer: It needs seed-list placement results, Postmaster exports, SNDS exports, ESP metrics, and any prior baseline.

faq.question: Can it send seed emails automatically?
faq.answer: Only when Resend is the ESP, and live sending should require explicit user confirmation.

faq.question: Does it check SPF, DKIM, or DMARC?
faq.answer: No. Use a deliverability QA skill for pre-send authentication checks.

faq.question: Does it score the full email quality audit?
faq.answer: No. It prepares a placement snapshot for a separate EQS audit.

faq.question: What happens when a provider is missing?
faq.answer: The skill marks that provider as NEEDS_INPUT and avoids pass-by-default conclusions.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It is described for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible skill hosts.
